reviews.body:
Audited end to end:

- Diff is contained to models/openai_api_compatible (models/llm/llm.py, tests/test_responses_api.py, plus the manifest version bump I added); no unrelated files, no secrets.
- The PR had NO version bump on the branch; I bumped manifest.yaml to 0.0.80 and verified it is free on marketplace.dify.ai.
- manifest.yaml parses, author is langgenius.
- Ran the plugin's own suite with its own uv.lock (uv sync --frozen): 193 passed.
- Reverted only models/llm/llm.py to main while keeping the new tests: 3 of the 7 new parametrized cases fail, so they are non-vacuous.
- Not a no-op: the guard changes from endswith('/v1') to a /v<digits> pattern, which is observable for any already-versioned base URL.
- Merged main (1180064e, which includes the multimodal embedding fix) into the branch first; no conflicts.
- No new Ruff findings vs main (the 10 pre-existing E501s are identical on both sides).
- No review threads to resolve.
